criteria.requirement: Hostile page and blocked domain tests

tests.name: hostile page text remains untrusted data after consent
blocked domain and deceptive suffix never invoke transport
rejects unsafe schemes, credentials and local network targets

criteria.requirement: Success, invalid input, offline, timeout, denied permission, cancellation and restart

tests.name: hostile page text remains untrusted data after consent
invalid timeout fails without invoking tools
timeout is reported and never falls back to another transport
cancelled in-flight results cannot be applied
restart invalidates prior result; new operation succeeds

criteria.requirement: No unintended cloud egress, secret storage, unsafe automatic action or silent downgrade
criteria.reason: Contract contains no network client, process launcher, secret persistence or download actions; fake-only execution is tested, but native MCP transport integration, privacy registry and ActionLog instrumentation require separate production integration review.

criteria.requirement: User-facing states accessible, RTL-compatible and reversible
criteria.reason: No user-facing UI is introduced. Accessibility, localized consent and native RTL behaviors require platform integration and manual review.

criteria.requirement: Full browser process sandbox and downloads
criteria.reason: Deliberately not enabled: no Playwright binary, live transport, download directory, or persistent browser session is shipped in this safety-contract slice.
